source_records.known: The displayed coding includes work, responsibility moves to user and back, and recorded closure plus explanation.
source_records.claim_limit: A coded return or close is not independent evidence of a successful repair. Do not reconstruct missing conversations.

source_records.kind: Aggregate departures reported in the draft
source_records.denominator_for_recalculated_rates: not reconstructed in this bounded reading
source_records.attribution_limit: No ticket-level matching, rate calculation or causal attribution. Customer-data waiting is an author-reported account, not established for every case.

project_inference: Track record status, expected next action and outcome evidence separately. Neither a neat action sequence nor an administrative ending alone answers whether relevant work succeeded.
candidate_question_not_adopted_by_resear: When a task is handed to another role for information or testing, who takes up the next action, what allows work to return or stop, and how is the outcome established?

proposed_fields.purpose: Link the same problem and a specific action; do not count every message as a new problem.
Keep source status and available timestamps; missing time remains unknown.
Separate a named responsibility in the record from evidence that the next actor accepted or performed it.
Record the information, test or decision required for the next transition.
Keep authority, missing information, technical feasibility and priority distinct when evidence permits.
Record what was verified, by whom, for which purpose and through what observation window; retain unknowns and later reopening.

fictional_checks.scenario: User confirms that the supplied repair works for the originally reported task.
fictional_checks.permitted_coding: Confirmed result for the stated task and observation window, not permanent reliability.

fictional_checks.scenario: A one-time fault cannot be reproduced and no customer test is available.
fictional_checks.permitted_coding: Administrative closure; technical resolution unknown. Closure may be reasonable.

fictional_checks.scenario: A repair has been sent; a specified customer test is still pending at cutoff.
fictional_checks.permitted_coding: Awaiting test at cutoff; neither failure nor confirmed repair.

fictional_checks.scenario: A test initially passed but the same symptom returned in the stated follow-up window.
fictional_checks.permitted_coding: Initial confirmation and later recurrence, kept as two dated observations.
